purpose: Test representability and trainability of each frozen physics-informed family on one complete historically exposed trajectory before any micropanel promotion.

scientific_boundary.reference: single bridge FEM model implemented and solved in COMSOL
scientific_boundary.comparison: each route versus the same FEM/COMSOL trajectory and common controls; never COMSOL versus FEM

outputs: incremental displacement u_X_v_Y_w_Z at the 512 identical observations
incremental velocity at the same observations
q and qdot where the route uses the admitted reduced state
data.acceleration: not a capacity target because no compatible full-saved-grid exact FEM/COMSOL qddot exists; no double differentiation of displacement
inputs: Beam graph properties and local frames for graph routes
time and case parameters only when available without response leakage

common_budget.mixed_precision: disabled until an explicit numerical-parity test passes

required: meaningful reduction from initialization or documented plateau
finite per-axis displacement and velocity metrics
physics diagnostics appropriate to the route
data-only ablation of approximately comparable capacity
capacity_admission.failure_handling: preserve checkpoint and evidence; then allow exactly one representation repair and one optimization repair before route closure can be considered later than the single-case stage

one_case_diagnostic_thresholds_not_final.purpose: detect clear representability failure without imposing final B2-level utility at capacity
one_case_diagnostic_thresholds_not_final.interpretation: Failure of a threshold diagnoses a repair target; it does not close a route from one case or one output. Final utility remains the paired B2 comparison under later OOF evidence.

physics_contract.physical32: variational or virtual-work residual is authorized
physics_contract.residual192: strong equation is forbidden; use data or graph residual representation
physics_contract.newmark: admitted causal physical anchor, not a reproduction of COMSOL generalized-alpha integration and not mandatory as the architecture of every family

R1_BRIDGE_PINO.physics: physical32 variational diagnostic/loss after normalized reduced projection
R1_BRIDGE_PINO.mandatory_ablation: same temporal operator without physics loss

R2_MO_PIGNO.mechanism: shared Beam-graph encoder with separate displacement and velocity heads
R2_MO_PIGNO.capacity_target: full graph latent field decoded at identical observations
R2_MO_PIGNO.physics: hard BC plus compatible physical32 variational and kinematic diagnostics; no forced positive cross-channel correlation
R2_MO_PIGNO.mandatory_ablation: capacity-matched graph operator without physics loss

R3_GRAPH_NEURAL_GALERKIN.mechanism: Beam-graph field operator with a compatible Galerkin test space
R3_GRAPH_NEURAL_GALERKIN.capacity_target: observation fields and reduced physical state
R3_GRAPH_NEURAL_GALERKIN.physics: virtual work on physical32; elementwise Beam assembly is required before claiming full Graph Galerkin implementation
R3_GRAPH_NEURAL_GALERKIN.mandatory_ablation: same graph field operator without variational loss

R4_PORT_HAMILTONIAN_OPINF.mechanism: constrained passive physical32 input-output core plus zero-initialized learned residual
R4_PORT_HAMILTONIAN_OPINF.physics: J skew, R positive semidefinite, Q positive definite, power balance

R5_ROTATION_MULTISCALE_GNO.mechanism: typed polar/axial local-frame messages with frozen fine-coarse-fine hierarchy
R5_ROTATION_MULTISCALE_GNO.capacity_target: Beam-graph latent field and observation response
R5_ROTATION_MULTISCALE_GNO.physics: frame covariance, rotation parity, directional Timoshenko properties and hard BC
R5_ROTATION_MULTISCALE_GNO.mandatory_ablation: same hierarchy with neutralized frames or directional properties

R6_LOAD_DEPENDENT_RITZ_KRYLOV.mechanism: load-conditioned Ritz/SOAR reduced propagator plus bounded graph residual
R6_LOAD_DEPENDENT_RITZ_KRYLOV.physics: second-order projected dynamics, force-direction coverage and M orthogonality

promotion_after_capacity: No route is promoted directly to factorial or OOF. Routes passing capacity enter the common three-case micropanel; failed routes consume their predeclared repairs before any scientific closure.
